lina: Quick check — I'm finishing the CLI error-ref PR and want final eyes on the examples around 429s, timeouts, and context-limit fallbacks. PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/3412
ben: On it. Which SDK snippets are we publishing? Python + Go?
lina: Both. The python snippet includes retries + parsing Retry-After header. I think current draft accidentally retries on all 4xx because of a broad except.
doc-sam: Paste the snippet here and I can run a quick lint + tiny integration test against the sandbox endpoint.
lina: ```python
# current draft (problematic)
for attempt in range(3):
    try:
        resp = client.generate(prompt)
        if resp.status_code == 200:
            return resp.json()
    except Exception:
        sleep(1 * attempt)
# this swallows client errors and retries everything
```
doc-sam: Found the issue — the bare except will retry non-transient errors. Suggest this instead: ```python
import time
from requests import HTTPError

for attempt in range(1,4):
    resp = client.generate(prompt)
    if resp.status_code == 200:
        return resp.json()
    if resp.status_code == 429:
        retry_after = int(resp.headers.get('Retry-After', '1'))
        time.sleep(retry_after)
        continue
    if 500 <= resp.status_code < 600:
        time.sleep(2 ** attempt)
        continue
    # non-retryable: raise so caller can handle gracefully
    resp.raise_for_status()
```
ben: Nice. Also add a short note about context-trimming for long prompts (we should link to the context-limits page) — e.g. recommend client-side prefix trimming + server-side fallback behavior. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/context-limits
marta: I'll update the PR description to include "what changed" and a changelog bullet for docs. Also adding a short callout in the migration guide for teams upgrading from old retry middleware.
ops-alex: Ops request: include a brief example of graceful fallback when Dedicated pool is saturated — state that the routing policy will fall back to a smaller model variant and show a minimal YAML routing snippet so infra knows what to expect:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  primary: rdx-large-1
  fallback:
    - rdx-medium-1
    - rdx-small-1
  on_capacity_exceeded: route_to_fallback
```
lina: Perfect. Final checklist: doc-sam add unit test for Retry-After parsing, ben quick-review Go example for context deadlines, marta update PR description and changelog, ops-alex confirm routing snippet wording. I'll push an update tonight and merge after approvals. :thumbsup:
